- [x] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

# What does this PR do?

Fix DSA index-share holder leakage across non-packed activation-checkpointed forwards.

When DSA index sharing is enabled, source-layer top-k indices and optional lengths are stored on a holder for reuse by subsequent layers. In the non-packed path, the fallback holder was attached to `attention_mask` or the transformer config, both of which can outlive a single model forward.

With multiple outstanding checkpointed forwards, a later forward could overwrite the holder before an earlier forward was recomputed. The earlier recompute could therefore consume top-k support from the wrong forward.

This change:

- creates one private holder carrier per `checkpointed_forward` invocation;
- enables it only for non-packed DSA with `dsa_indexer_topk_freq > 1`;
- captures the carrier in each activation-checkpoint closure;
- preserves `PackedSeqParams` as the preferred holder for packed training;
- keeps the existing source-layer top-k recomputation and layer ordering unchanged;
- adds a regression test covering F1 -> F2 -> B1 -> B2 holder isolation.

## Issue tracking

Linked issue: N/A

## Contribution process

### Pre-checks

- [x] I have added relevant unit tests
- [ ] I have added relevant functional tests
- [x] I have added proper typing to my code [Typing guidelines](https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html)
- [ ] I have added relevant documentation
- [x] I have run the [autoformatter.sh](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/main/tools/autoformat.sh) on my PR

## Testing

Passed:

- targeted non-packed checkpoint holder-isolation regression test;
- DSA index-share unit-test subset (`-k "index_share"`);
- `BASE_REF=main CHECK_ONLY=true SKIP_DOCS=false bash tools/autoformat.sh`.

Functional validation will be requested through the `Run functional tests` PR label.

@NVIDIA/mcore-oncall Could you please add the Run functional tests label? This fix touches the DSA attention/indexer numerical path.

Live GLM 5.2 evidence from a two-node B300 run supports this fix.

Exact MCore base `67b6ae70e6556fea6cc4f9df824b18d6544f8ac9` completed model initialization, weight publication, 16/16 sampling, and the pre-update logprob forward. Backward then failed during activation recomputation at DSA layer 78 because the source indices from layer 75 were absent: `Holder has layers []`.

The workload is dense/non-packed and uses full activation recompute with `recompute_method=uniform`. I cherry-picked this PR unchanged onto the exact base as `16512be1ac1ee440c8b869db4ad9ad5eafc1a056`. The existing non-packed test passes, and locally parameterizing the test over both `block` and `uniform` gives 7/7 passing `index_share` tests.

Run: `glm52-m1a-native-2step-20260829h`
Service: `skyrl-glm52-2n-direct-0-e20f672a`
Durable log: `/mnt/shared-volume/milestone1/logs/skyrl-glm52-2n-direct-0-e20f672a-20260829T034532Z.log`

Suggestion: include `uniform` in the regression parameterization because that is the live mode that exposed the holder-lifetime failure.

Follow-up: the corrected two-node B300 replay now passes the exact live path that previously failed.

- Run: `glm52-m1a-native-dsa-recompute-20260829k`
- MCore integration: `16512be1ac1ee440c8b869db4ad9ad5eafc1a056` (this PR unchanged at `cda9ebb1`)
- Shape: dense/non-packed GLM 5.2, `recompute_method=uniform`, two disaggregated 8-GPU nodes
- Result: 32/32 terminal rollouts, two forward/backward passes, two optimizer updates, two durable checkpoints, zero pod restarts
- Step 1/2 gradient norms: 0.171 / 0.115
- Step 1/2 policy-train time: 33.24s / 11.98s

This converts the prior reproduction into a successful end-to-end regression receipt for the fix. I still recommend adding `uniform` to the focused test parameterization.

Thanks @hershg for the detailed reproduction and end-to-end validation!

I've parameterized the existing holder-isolation regression over both `block` and `uniform` in b05f1532cdb9e5d5d72e0e7b6dd98128fc591fd5, as suggested. Both modes now exercise the same F1 -> F2 -> B1 -> B2 holder-isolation assertions. This update only extends test coverage; the implementation is unchanged.

+class _DSAIndexShareCarrier:
+    """Per-forward DSA index-share carrier for non-packed activation recompute."""
+
+
+_CURRENT_DSA_INDEX_SHARE_CARRIER: ContextVar[Optional[object]] = ContextVar(
+    "current_dsa_index_share_carrier", default=None
+)
+
+
+@contextmanager
+def _dsa_index_share_carrier_scope(carrier: object) -> Iterator[None]:
+    """Expose one non-packed forward's index-share carrier to its checkpoint closures."""
+    token = _CURRENT_DSA_INDEX_SHARE_CARRIER.set(carrier)
+    try:
+        yield
+    finally:
+        _CURRENT_DSA_INDEX_SHARE_CARRIER.reset(token)
+

             return packed_seq_params

         return attention_mask if attention_mask is not None else self.config

 )
 from megatron.core.packed_seq_params import PackedSeqParams
 from megatron.core.process_groups_config import ProcessGroupCollection
+from megatron.core.recompute import checkpointed_forward
 from megatron.core.tensor_parallel.random import model_parallel_cuda_manual_seed
 from megatron.core.transformer.enums import AttnMaskType
 from megatron.core.transformer.experimental_attention_variant import dsa_indexer_loss, dsa_kernels
@@ -198,6 +199,91 @@ def test_index_share_holder_uses_packed_seq_params_when_available(self):
         assert not hasattr(attention_mask, DSAttention._HOLDER_ATTR)
         assert not hasattr(attention_mask, DSAttention._LENGTH_HOLDER_ATTR)
 
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("recompute_method", ["block", "uniform"])
+    def test_nonpacked_checkpointed_forwards_keep_index_share_holders_isolated(
+        self, monkeypatch, recompute_method
+    ):
+        config = SimpleNamespace(
+            dsa_indexer_topk=8,
+            dsa_indexer_topk_freq=4,
+            dsa_indexer_skip_topk_offset=1,
+            kv_channels=16,
+        )
+        attention = DSAttention(
+            config=config,
+            submodules=DSAttentionSubmodules(indexer=object()),
+            layer_number=2,
+            attn_mask_type=AttnMaskType.causal,
+            attention_type="self",
+            softmax_scale=1.0,
+            pg_collection=SimpleNamespace(),
+        )
+        recomputed_supports = []
+
+        class HolderLayer:
+            layer_number = 2
+
+            def __call__(self, hidden_states, attention_mask, packed_seq_params, **_kwargs):
+                topk_holder = attention._get_index_share_topk_holder(
+                    packed_seq_params, attention_mask
+                )
+                length_holder = attention._get_index_share_topk_length_holder(
+                    packed_seq_params, attention_mask
+                )
+                if torch.is_grad_enabled():
+                    recomputed_supports.append((topk_holder[1].clone(), length_holder[1].clone()))
+                else:
+                    topk_holder[1] = hidden_states.detach().to(torch.int64)
+                    length_holder[1] = hidden_states.detach().to(torch.int32)
+                return hidden_states
+
+        block = SimpleNamespace(
+            config=SimpleNamespace(
+                experimental_attention_variant="dsa",
+                dsa_indexer_topk_freq=4,
+                fp8=False,
+                fp4=False,
+                distribute_saved_activations=False,
+                recompute_method=recompute_method,
+                recompute_num_layers=1,
+            ),
+            layers=[HolderLayer()],
+            num_layers_per_pipeline_rank=1,
+            pg_collection=SimpleNamespace(tp=None),
+        )
+        checkpoint_calls = []
+
+        def fake_checkpoint(function, _distribute_saved_activations, *args):
+            checkpoint_calls.append((function, args))
+            with torch.no_grad():
+                return function(*args)
+
+        monkeypatch.setattr(
+            "megatron.core.transformer.utils.tensor_parallel.checkpoint", fake_checkpoint
+        )
+        shared_attention_mask = torch.empty(1)
+        for value in (1.0, 2.0):
+            checkpointed_forward(
+                block,
+                hidden_states=torch.tensor([value]),
+                attention_mask=shared_attention_mask,
+                context=None,
+                context_mask=None,
+                rotary_pos_emb=torch.empty(1),
+                attention_bias=None,
+                packed_seq_params=None,
+                use_inner_quantization_context=False,
+            )
+
+        for function, args in checkpoint_calls:
+            with torch.enable_grad():
+                function(*args)
+
+        assert [support.item() for support, _length in recomputed_supports] == [1, 2]
+        assert [length.item() for _support, length in recomputed_supports] == [1, 2]
+        assert not hasattr(shared_attention_mask, DSAttention._HOLDER_ATTR)
+        assert not hasattr(shared_attention_mask, DSAttention._LENGTH_HOLDER_ATTR)
+
 
 def _build_packed_causal_mask_for_test(
     query_idx: torch.Tensor, key_idx: torch.Tensor, cu_seqlens: torch.Tensor
